primary_number: Employer 4%, Employee 1%, Total 5% of salary/wage; salary cap Rp 12,000,000/month (Pasal 30 and Pasal 32, Perpres 64/2020)
publisher: Sekretariat Negara / Indonesian Government (Presidential Regulation No. 64 of 2020 — Perubahan Kedua atas Perpres No. 82 Tahun 2018 tentang Jaminan Kesehatan). PDF also downloadable from BPK JDIH: https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Download/127554/Perpres%20Nomor%2064%20Tahun%202020.pdf and JDIH Kemenkeu: https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/dok/perpres-64-tahun-2020
methodology_note: PDF of the primary Presidential Regulation was accessed via markitdown and the exact article text was extracted and verified. Pasal 30 ayat (1) states: 'Iuran bagi Peserta PPU yaitu sebesar 5% dari Gaji atau Upah per bulan dengan ketentuan: (a) 4% dibayar oleh Pemberi Kerja; dan (b) 1% dibayar oleh Peserta.' Pasal 32 ayat (1) states: 'Batas paling tinggi Gaji atau Upah per bulan yang digunakan sebagai dasar perhitungan besaran Iuran bagi Peserta PPU yaitu sebesar Rp12.000.000,00 (dua belas juta rupiah).' Two subsequent amendments (Perpres 63/2022 on PBPU class restructuring, and Perpres 59/2024 on KRIS transition) did NOT change PPU rates or the salary cap. As of May 2026, rates remain unchanged — a potential rate increase for 2026 is under study but not yet enacted.

Rates and cap unchanged by Perpres 63/2022 and Perpres 59/2024; confirmed current as of May 2026. Cap: employer maximum contribution = 4% x Rp 12,000,000 = Rp 480,000/month.
